name: Tumbleweed Minion
flavour: Sworn to the crown. Not sure which one.
art_prompt: a small round tumbleweed creature made of dry tangled brown twigs, with a serious stern face: narrow squinting eyes, thick straight eyebrows and a flat grim mouth, wearing a simple plain brown cloth peasant's cap, no crown, no gold, no arms, no legs, a loyal commoner soldier of the tumbleweeds, facing the viewer
anim_negative: arms, legs, hands, a crown, a smile, an open mouth, extra eyes, two creatures, the face moving or talking
back_hint: seen from behind: the round tangle of twigs and the back of the cloth cap, no face
dead_hint: lying on its side on the ground, dead: the ball of twigs sagged and flattened, eyes shut, the cloth cap fallen off beside it
doc: The Tumbleweed King's own: little tumbleweed knights in commoner caps, goblins in all but looks and a touch faster. The King's ring calls them instead of goblins.

TM-0.note: Pass 45: the brown cloth cap and the big stern face (kept to come back to)
